# BARCOLA167 AMP AI Agent Disclosure

## Description
BARCOLA167 is a digital portal landing page. The site provides promotional marketing content for the BARCOLA167 brand, redirects to the official portal at https://bro.barcola167.com, and serves an AMP version at https://ampbarcola167.pages.dev.
